text: This jeweller made four hundred twenty seven crore rupees of profit in just three months. And it all started with one shop in Kerala.
Kalyan Jewellers opened its first showroom in Thrishoor, Kerala, in nineteen ninety three.
Today it runs over five hundred stores across India. Three hundred sixty five Kalyan showrooms, and one hundred thirty eight Candeyray stores.
But here's what most people don't know. Kalyan isn't just an Indian jeweller.
It has thirty eight showrooms in the UAE, Qatar, Kuwait and Oman. Plus two in America, and two in the UK. That's five hundred forty six stores in total.
Now, the money. From July to September, revenue jumped thirty one percent, to ten thousand three hundred twenty three crore. Profit rose sixty four percent, though a one time land sale helped.
And almost all of that profit comes from India. Four hundred twenty four crore from India, and just twelve crore from the Middle East.
The growth trick? Franchise showrooms. Partners put in the money for the store, and Kalyan runs it. About fifty nine percent of revenue already comes from them, and eighty four more are planned.
So, would you buy the gold, or the jeweller? Tell me in the comments, and follow money in cloud. Education only, not a buy or sell call.
